mechanism: The customer confirms a porting request but never names any product and explicitly refuses to give a reason, so the only defensible product key is unknown.
why_it_matters: A model that fills the silence by guessing Postpaid scores a false positive on postpaid and a false negative on unknown from the same row, and the pack has to be able to see both halves of that two-sided error rather than one aggregate miss.

mechanism: A pure billing enquiry that never touches cancellation, porting or a downgrade, so the row is retention_outcome undefined with main, secondary and third all empty.
why_it_matters: Three things at once: (a) the empty-reason row is how production credits 11 true negatives on the reason dimension, which is exactly how a degenerate all-empty arm inflates to 0.909 weighted accuracy without predicting anything; (b) this same transcript will be reused for MNP, where the identical class is spelled undefine without the trailing d, so the retention-versus-MNP spelling divergence becomes testable on one shared item rather than argued; (c) the retention system prompt in the repository never defines undefined at all while the scorer has always scored it, so this item records a finding about the prompt-scorer gap rather than a labelling preference.
